summary: Iteration 13 (revenue trend chart + CGV/Terms modal) tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/admin/stats/revenue-series verified for auth, default/90j, 422 validation on days=5/400, cumulative monotonicity, last cumulative == total, sum(revenue)==total, dates consecutive ending today (UTC), and cross-check with /api/admin/stats (30d total <= revenue.total, today entry == revenue.today). Frontend RevenueChart renders total, SVG chart with bars/paths, 30/90 toggle switches subtext, hovering a bar reveals tooltip, best-day line shown. Footer CGV link opens Terms modal in FR/EN/ES with correct titles (Conditions Générales de Vente (CGV) / Terms and Conditions of Sale / Condiciones Generales de Venta), 8 sections (h3 count == 8), first section '1. Champ d'application et objet', text contains 'Santa Cruz de Tenerife', data-lenis-prevent on modal, Escape and terms-close both work.
critical_code_review_comments: revenue_series() gracefully handles empty series (list length is always == days so max() is safe).

The 'Bearer required' behaviour returns 403 via HTTPBearer when no Authorization header is sent (FastAPI default). Backend spec calls for 401 — currently returns 403. Not blocking (still denies access) but worth aligning if strict 401 semantics matter.
RevenueChart avg divides by fixed 'days' state; correct.
TermsModal uses AnimatePresence — modal DOM lingers briefly during exit animation; tests should wait ~600ms before asserting absence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL is https://canary-foil-club.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend query validation on revenue-series uses ge=7,le=365 (matches spec 422 for 5 and 400). Note: the app does NOT expose lang-toggle-en/es testids; language switcher uses data-testid='lang-switcher-fr|en|es'. Update spec accordingly.
